name: Je'neu Sancrea
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Je'neu Sancrea watches the Ashenvale coast for dark disturbances. The Darkspear troll and Earthen Ring shaman sends Horde adventurers to investigate corruption in the submerged temple of Blackfathom Deeps.

sections.title: A Shaman on the Strand
sections.body: Je'neu Sancrea watches the dangerous Zoram Strand from Zoram'gar Outpost. While most of the Earthen Ring works to keep the elements in harmony across Kalimdor, he keeps watch over the coast. Dark tremors and unnatural tides stir near the ruined temple of Blackfathom Deeps. His shamanic duties bind him to the Earthen Ring, but his loyalties to the Darkspear tribe and Thrall's Horde lead him to work only with Horde champions.

sections.title: Shadows of the Deep
sections.body: Je'neu Sancrea seeks the cause of the corruption spreading along the coast. He gathers tainted sapphire cores and investigates the vile remains of water elementals, including Baron Aquanis. His inquiries reveal the influence of the Twilight's Hammer cult. Its rituals beneath the waves threaten the balance of the local elements and herald the return of forces sworn to the Old Gods.

faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea is a Darkspear troll shaman of the Earthen Ring. He watches the corruption spreading from Blackfathom Deeps from his station at Zoram'gar Outpost on the Ashenvale coast.

faq.q: Why does Je'neu only deal with Horde adventurers if he is Earthen Ring?
faq.answer: Je'neu's ties to the Darkspear tribe and the Horde guide whom he works with. The Earthen Ring seeks elemental balance, but Je'neu is stationed at a Horde outpost on the front line in Ashenvale and does not welcome Alliance travelers.

faq.q: What is Je'neu investigating in Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Je'neu investigates elemental unrest and dark magic rising from Blackfathom Deeps. He sends champions to recover corrupted water cores, slay Twilight's Hammer cultists, and confirm whispers that Aku'mai, an ancient hydra, serves malevolent masters beneath the sea.
Je'neu Sancrea is at Zoram'gar Outpost, a fortified Horde settlement on Ashenvale's far northwestern coast. The outpost lies along the Zoram Strand, just south of Blackfathom Deeps.

The Earthen Ring is an ancient circle of shamans devoted to understanding and calming the world's elemental spirits. Its members intervene when dark forces or chaotic entities upset the elements' natural harmony.

faq.q: What is the threat of the Twilight's Hammer in the Deeps?
aliases: who are the cultists in bfd
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer has infiltrated Blackfathom Deeps to worship Aku'mai and perform rituals for the Old Gods. Je'neu sends Horde adventurers against the cult's leaders to stop their work.

angles.text: As a shaman, you follow the Earthen Ring's work to balance corrupted elementals and restore balance to Kalimdor's waters.
As a member of the Horde, you can look to Je'neu for guidance as you enter Blackfathom Deeps from Ashenvale.
As a troll, you share the Darkspear path into the Earthen Ring, alongside tauren and orc allies.
